name: Transaction Operation Type 11 Code
definition: Specifies the transaction operation action type.

CORR.name: Correction
CORR.definition: Transaction corrects errors in a previously sent transaction.

MARU.name: Margin Update
MARU.definition: Indicates the report of the collateral data or of their modifications, but not the corrections of the previously reported collateral details.

EROR.name: Error
EROR.definition: Cancellation of a wrongly submitted entire report in case the contract never came into existence or was not subject to regulatory reporting requirements but was reported to a regulatory authority by mistake or a cancellation of duplicate report.
